If the key were of an inappropriate type for the map, the put would have thrown ClassCastException, so ClassCastException is avoided because the same key was already accepted. Additionally, there is no explicit check for these exceptions, but the prior put operation ensures the key is valid for the map, preventing the conditions for ClassCastException and NullPointerException. Therefore, all three exceptions are avoided. No exceptions are left unhandled.
